ModMetaData.name: Caravans Critically Enhanced
ModMetaData.author: Zei33
ModMetaData.description: In development, and not yet released. So far it adds a Load work type next to Haul: colonists who are not going with a forming caravan help load it and lead its pen animals to it, and loading carries on while any listed item can still be fetched. Drafting a colonist leading animals for a caravan no longer drops its leads. A caravan leaves by a map edge inside the allowed area of every pawn restricted to one, away from hostiles where it can, and if no edge fits every area it packs and waits where it gathered, with an alert, until one does. A drafted colonist near the map edge can send the caravan off from there at once, bringing its downed colonists along wherever someone undrafted can fetch them, and Force depart now lists the downed colonists and babies it would abandon. When finished it will fix the other slow and fragile parts of forming a caravan as well: cargo already on pack animals will stay listed, and a caravan will move its exit away from enemies that turn up while it forms.
